test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 29 Dec, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Seven people, A, B, C, D, E, F and G, are sitting in a row, facing north. B sits third from the right end. Only one person sits to the left of D. F sits to the right of B but left of G. E is an immediate neighbour of C and D. How many people sit between A and G?
solution:
Given: Seven people, A, B, C, D, E, F and G, are sitting in a row, facing north.

1) B sits third from the right end.

2) Only one person sits to the left of D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d6219df942dfc80b96039f9d499d6c701bd0ab3cbaf6aeb741ed8884d972b3f8.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/80f347506204868365fda6a68a9fa70ff3f37829b219b35eae9b0147cb2f1068.png] 

3) E is an immediate neighbour of C and D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b2a74aaaf27d2da4b3391acf8d13ddeed5d45950cac807195f85681c9257c70d.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6a5baf65b93d58552bb2b47f6bf2d315f9e92234230ec8706d191a342119e6c7.png] 

4) F sits to the right of B but left of G.

After positioning F and G only one position is left which will be occupied by the only person left i.e. A.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/00735bbd41fb21ea84a5ce8993f96857ac5edf94085517ae779969f6c9df0ece.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d72c8c249d6deb6216b0e8a35bfeec445ddba520ff0374c956a5c26054667851.png] 

Thus, according to the final arrangement, five people sit between A and G.

Hence, "Option 3" is the correct answer.
